────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 ☐ Retention

Keep ghosted sessions for how long before deleting them?

❯ 1. 24 hours (Recommended)
     Long enough to recreate them after a tmux server restart.
  2. 1 hour
     A short window with less clutter in the sidebar.
  3. Until dismissed
     Never delete them automatically.
  4. Type something.

Enter to select · ↑/↓ to navigate · Esc to cancel
